description: Evaluate whether 0xaporia's regime/trend observations improve regime prediction and downstream strategy activation.

experiments.name: State prediction vs baseline
experiments.h0: Aporia contains no incremental regime information beyond price/breadth.
experiments.h1: Aporia regime events improve Brier score and log-loss over baseline.
experiments.baseline: lagged 24h return + 7d volatility + alt breadth percentile

experiments.name: Trend persistence after Aporia says TREND
experiments.h0: When Aporia says TREND, future trend persistence is no different from baseline.
experiments.h1: When Aporia says TREND, trend persistence is higher than baseline.
experiments.metric: future return / trailing volatility (Sharpe-like), directional efficiency, max drawdown at 1d/3d/7d
experiments.control: compare to all periods where baseline regime = same state
experiments.falsification: no improvement in trend persistence metric with n>=10

experiments.name: Transition lead/lag
experiments.h0: Aporia does not lead objective regime transitions.
experiments.h1: Aporia's regime changes lead objective regime changes by >= 1 day.

experiments.name: Downstream strategy activation
experiments.h0: Aporia regime gating does not improve downstream strategy EV.
experiments.h1: Strategies gated by Aporia regime calls improve EV, Sharpe, and drawdown.
experiments.falsification: no improvement in any strategy with n>=10
